title: Advantech WebAccess
overview: VULNERABILITY OVERVIEW SQL INJECTION CWE-89 To be able to exploit the SQL injection vulnerability, an attacker must supply malformed input to the WebAccess software. Successful attack could result in administrative access to the application and its data files. CVE-2017-5154 has been assigned to this vulnerability. A CVSS v3 base score of 9.8 has been assigned; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ). AUTHENTICATION BYPASS ISSUES CWE-592 By accessing a specific uniform resource locator (URL) on the web server, a malicious user is able to access pages unrestricted. CVE-2017-5152 has been assigned to this vulnerability. A CVSS v3 base score of 9.1 has been assigned; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N ).
